note: Submodule of registration. Lets an existing registration be moved to another host. Config object registration_change_host.settings has `workflow` (multistep default | single_step) plus title strings; per-type third-party allow_data_loss; permissions change host any/own registration; manager service registration_change_host.manager. Cases are grounded in that config object and permissions.

evals.prompt: What does the Registration Change Host submodule let you do, and which two change flows does it support?
evals.expected_output: It lets an existing registration be moved to a different host entity. Two flows selected by registration_change_host.settings.workflow: `multistep` (choose a new host, then confirm) or `single_step` (one form).

evals.prompt: Which permissions does Registration Change Host add to control who may move a registration to a different host?
evals.expected_output: `change host any registration` (any registration) and `change host own registration` (the user's own registrations).

evals.prompt: In Registration Change Host, what per-registration-type setting decides whether a registration may be moved to a host of a different registration type (where type-specific field data could be lost)?
evals.expected_output: The third-party boolean `allow_data_loss` on the registration type (registration.type.*.third_party.registration_change_host.allow_data_loss, default false).

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the Registration Change Host configuration and state which change-host flow is currently in use (single-step or the multistep select-then-confirm flow).
On this site, configure Registration Change Host to use the single-step change-host form (rather than the multistep flow), and apply the change to the live site.
